limitations: This review confirms internal provenance, arithmetic and stated evidence semantics; it is not an independently rerun provider experiment.
Four correlated layouts with authored diagnostic states; 64 calls are not 64 independent real-world tasks.
RGB and telemetry use different observability reference labels; their accuracy difference is not a general accuracy-gain estimate.
No false complete verdicts were observed, but telemetry recognized only one of eight physical positives; this does not establish a reliable completion detector.
Telemetry is privileged simulator state, not a validated robot sensor or camera estimator.
Latency includes request preparation, upload, network, hosted response and parsing from preloaded images; rendering, camera capture and actuation are excluded.
Cost is derived from returned input usage and the frozen documented price; it is not a billing receipt.
No learned controller, direct actuator loop, local Jev execution or real-robot transfer is demonstrated.
review_scope: Independent read-only review of the completed frozen provider run; no requests rerun and no protocol or scorer edits.
